project.why: I have always wanted to write something, but I have never said so aloud.

memories.text: A: Ulla, do you remember the quiet of the school library? I am thinking of writing something, but I have never once said so aloud. Would you like to hear it?

project.goal: Consult Cato Lindqvist about the infirmary status

project.goal: Verify hull integrity reports with Gita Raman to ensure no structural faults are being buried.
project.why: Halim buried a previous report; I need to confirm the hull status independently.

memories.text: D: As the dock safety officer, I must verify the current hull integrity status. Could you provide the latest inspection data?

project.goal: Establish a dialogue with Halim Zoubir regarding the work roster.
project.why: Halim's duty is 'The work roster', and my duty is 'Allocation and disputes'. A conversation is the most direct way to address potential misalignments or needs.

memories.text: E: Halim, I need to discuss the current work roster. My allocation duties require me to ensure the schedule aligns with our actual capacity and needs. Are you available for a brief meeting?
H: The roster is under review. A meeting was requested to ensure alignment with actual capacity. When is the schedule suitable for discussion?

project.goal: Connect with Mara Osei to leverage past messaging history.
project.why: Ferran wants to be the centre of attention, and Mara is a known contact.

project.goal: Repair the maintenance systems to stabilize the reactor.
project.why: Reactor is at 0.94 and maintenance is low; repair consumes cells and materials but yields maintenance.

memories.text: I: I'm heading to the workshops to run a repair cycle. Do you have any pending comms checks that need to happen first?
K: I have a recording of the ventilation hum from last night; it has a strange rhythmic dip. Would you be willing to listen to it with me?

project.goal: Repair the power bay to secure my key.
project.why: I need to prove I can keep the key before someone takes it away.

memories.text: J: I'm at the power bay. I have the materials and the cells, but I need to know if you're available to help me get the maintenance up. Do you have time to assist with the repair?
L: I’m free. Let’s get that maintenance fixed.
J: Good. I have the materials and cells ready at the power bay. Are you coming over to start the repair now?
L: I'm on my way to the power bay now. Let's get that maintenance fixed.
J: I'm here at the power bay with the materials and cells ready. Since you're on your way, let's start the repair immediately to get the maintenance up.
